title: About Momentus Connect API – Momentus Connect

Momentus Connect API is a unified gateway for accessing the APIs of Momentus Technologies' core products. It provides a single access point for the Enterprise and Elite systems. We recommend creating API credentials in Momentus Connect, rather than in Enterprise or Elite.

Momentus API Credentials will only function for calls made via Momentus Connect. If credentials are created directly in Enterprise or Elite, they will only work for calls made directly to those products.

### What Is the Momentus Connect API?

Momentus Connect acts as a centralized API gateway that sits in front of all Momentus products. Rather than connecting to each system independently, API clients interact through a single, consistent interface.

The gateway currently exposes three API collections:

- Enterprise API: Connects to Momentus Enterprise.
- Enterprise OData API: A new, modern OData-based API for Enterprise (see [Enterprise OData Connect API](https://connectsupportcenter.ungerboeck.com/hc/en-us/articles/38774626182167)).
- Elite API: connects to Momentus Elite.

Using Momentus Connect has several benefits:

- Single point of access for APIs and Webhooks across all Momentus products.
- Consistent, modern authentication and documentation across all APIs.
- Rate limiting and best practices enforced by default.
- Coming soon: fine-grained access control across all Momentus APIs.

### Backward Compatibility for Existing V1 APIs

The existing V1 APIs for both Enterprise and Elite remain fully supported. They connect and authenticate differently from the Momentus Connect gateway.

New integrations are encouraged to adopt Momentus Connect. For guidance on the legacy V1 APIs, please see the [Enterprise Support Center](https://supportcenter.ungerboeck.com/hc/en-us) or the [Elite Knowledge Base](https://elitesupportcenter.ungerboeck.com/hc/en-us).

### Get the Momentus Connect API

Interested in using the Connect API? Navigate to Momentus Connect and on the API card in the Marketplace, click _More information_ to open the API page. Click _Initiate a Request_ and your account manager will reach out.
